column1: # Harness adjustments: provider-specific prompt lines, each answering recurring friction (tab-separated).
# Runners add matching lines to implement, review, research and advise prompts; no match adds nothing.
# model_glob is a bash pattern on the exact model id; mode is implement, review, research, advise or *.
# {budget} in line becomes the leg's turn or step cap (Grok, Muse, Vibe; Claude with --max-turns).
# evidence: friction-report row, issue URL or dated observation. as_of: YYYY-MM-DD.
# Remove a row once friction-report.sh no longer flags its friction.
# Override the whole table with MMO_HARNESS_ADJUSTMENTS=<file> in the same format.

column4: You have at most {budget} agent turns: make the edits early, keep dev-server, screenshot and exploration loops short, and leave room to run the named test and write your final message.
